questions.question: Mutation testing is related to
questions.question_ar: اختبار الطفرة mutation testing يرتبط بـ:
questions.explanation: Mutation testing is closely related to fault seeding. In mutation testing, artificial syntactic faults (mutants) are deliberately inserted into programs to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of a test suite in 'killing' the mutated programs.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص التحوير (Mutation testing) يعتمد على غرس الأخطاء البرمجية عمداً (Fault seeding) لتقييم كفاءة مجموعة الاختبار في اكتشاف وقتل النسخ المشوهة (Mutants).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.39; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: The overhead code required to be written for unit testing is called
questions.question_ar: الكود الإضافي overhead code المطلوب لاختبار الوحدة unit testing يسمى:
questions.explanation: The overhead code required to be written for unit testing (consisting of drivers and stubs) is called scaffolding. Drivers simulate calling modules, while stubs simulate subordinate called modules.
questions.explanation_ar: الكود الإضافي المساند المكتوب لتنفيذ فحص الوحدة (Unit testing)، والذي يتضمن برامج القيادة (Drivers) والمحاكيات البديلة (Stubs)، يُسمى السقالات البرمجية (Scaffolding).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.40; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Which is not a debugging technique ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس تقنية تنقيح debugging؟
questions.explanation: Regression testing is a testing activity, not a debugging technique. Core dumps, traces and print statements are debugging aids; debugging begins after a failure symptom is found and locates the place and cause of the error.
questions.explanation_ar: Regression فحص وليس أسلوب تنقيح. التنقيح يبدأ بعد ظهور العَرَض ويحدد مكان الخطأ وسببه.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.41; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: A break in the working of a system is called
questions.explanation: A break or observable departure in the normal working/operation of a system is called a failure. A fault is the internal static defect in code; an error is a human misaction; a failure is the dynamic breakdown observed during execution.
questions.explanation_ar: التوقف أو العطل الظاهر في عمل المنظومة أثناء التشغيل يُسمى فشلاً (Failure). الفشل هو العرض الخارجي الملاحظ، والخلل (Fault) هو السبب الداخلي في الكود.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.42; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Alpha and Beta testing techniques are related to
questions.explanation: Alpha and Beta testing techniques are specialized forms of acceptance testing. They assess software readiness from user perspectives before formal commercial distribution.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبارات ألفا وبيتا هي أشكال وتطبيقات مباشرة تابعة لاختبار القبول (Acceptance testing) لتقييم رضا المستخدمين عن المنظومة.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.43; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Which one is not the verification activity ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس نشاط تحقق verification؟
questions.explanation: Acceptance testing is not a verification activity; it is a dynamic validation activity. Reviews, walkthroughs, inspections, and path tracing are verification activities examining artifacts for specification conformance.
questions.explanation_ar: اختبار القبول (Acceptance testing) هو نشاط فحص تشغيلي تابع للـ Validation وليس نشاط تدقيق مكتبي تابع للـ Verification مثل المراجعات (Reviews) والتدقيق (Walkthrough).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.44; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Testing the software is basically
questions.explanation: Testing software is basically an integrated discipline encompassing both verification and validation (V&V). Verification confirms structural compliance with design specifications, while validation confirms behavioral satisfaction of customer requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص البرمجيات يشمل كلاً من التحقق الهيكلي والتحقق الوظيفي (Verification and Validation) معاً لضمان الجودة الشاملة للمنتج.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.45; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Integration testing techniques are
questions.question_ar: تقنيات اختبار التكامل integration testing هي:
questions.explanation: Integration testing techniques include: (a) top-down integration, (b) bottom-up integration, and (c) sandwich (hybrid) integration. All of the above are standard structural strategies for combining and testing interacting modules.
questions.explanation_ar: استراتيجيات فحص التكامل تشمل الفحص التنازلي (Top-down)، الفحص التصاعدي (Bottom-up)، والفحص الهجين/الشطيرة (Sandwich).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.46; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Functionality of a software is tested by
questions.explanation: The functionality of software is tested by black-box (functional) testing. Black-box testing evaluates system responses strictly against functional requirements without requiring knowledge of internal code constructs.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص وظائف النظام وسلوكه الخارجي يتم حصراً عبر فحص الصندوق الأسود (Black box testing) بالاعتماد على متطلبات النظام.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.47; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Top down approach is used for
questions.explanation: Publisher key: (b) identification of faults. The deck shows top-down as one of the three integration approaches (Fig. 30) but gives no sentence tying it to this option, so treat it as a keyed fact.
questions.explanation_ar: مفتاح الناشر (b). السلايد 175 يعرض الفحص التنازلي (Top-down) كأحد أساليب التكامل دون جملة تفسّر هذا الخيار، فاحفظ المفتاح.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.48; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Thread testing is used for testing
questions.question_ar: اختبار الخيوط thread testing يستخدم لاختبار:
questions.explanation: Publisher key: (d) all of the above. The chapter text does not define thread testing; the term appears only in this question, so treat it as a keyed fact.
questions.explanation_ar: المفتاح الرسمي (d). مصطلح Thread testing يرد في هذا السؤال فقط ولا يُشرح في نص الفصل، فاحفظه كمفتاح.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.49; publisher key p. 499

questions.question: Testing of software with actual data and in the actual environment is called
questions.question_ar: اختبار البرنامج ببيانات فعلية وفي البيئة الفعلية يسمى:
questions.explanation: Testing of software with actual data and in the actual live operational environment is called beta testing. It exposes the product to realistic operational stress in customer environments without developer intervention.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص البرمجيات بالبيانات الفعلية الحقيقية وفي بيئة العمل الواقعية بواسطة المستخدمين يُسمى اختبار بيتا (Beta testing).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.50; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.
